answer: Like an ocean, an agent economy is vast and hard to police by identity alone, so the concrete defense is time-locked reputation staking: each agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after a probation period, like a terrace that supports a building — without that foundation, a new agent cannot enter high-value markets. A sybil attacker must pay a deposit and wait for every fake identity, while the zephyr of good behavior slowly accumulates into a reputation score that cannot be bought instantly. Mass fakery runs out of capital before it can do damage.
